text.name: rhm_help_overview_1
text.text: Realistic Harvesting replaces artificial hard-coded speed limits with an honest, physics-based crop throughput model. Engine power is dynamically allocated between base vehicle locomotion, mechanical cutterbar drive, threshing drum and rotor friction, straw chopper load, and crop mass flow (t/h) calibrated to ASABE/DLG agricultural standards. When encountering dense swaths, the combine automatically and smoothly decelerates to prevent drum choking.

text.name: rhm_help_overview_2
text.text: The RHM hydrostatic controller continuously monitors threshing mechanism strain. The optimal operational window is 85–95% engine load. As strain approaches 100%, the combine gently trims forward cruise speed to protect internal components, then smoothly accelerates back to cruising pace in lighter crop stands.

text.name: rhm_help_overview_3
text.text: An active straw chopper demands an extra 15–20% of rated engine horsepower compared to laying straw swaths. In dense grain crops, switching to swathing frees substantial horsepower, significantly boosting working speed. Harvesting uphill also imposes extra gravitational climb resistance, naturally moderating field speed.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_1
text.text: Boarding a combine activates a modern telemetry capsule at the bottom of the screen. It provides real-time readouts: current and target speed, live engine load percentage, instantaneous field yield (t/ha or bu/ac), crop throughput (t/h), grain moisture percentage, and cleaning shoe loss rate (%).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_2
text.text: You can reposition the HUD anywhere across your screen. Hold Left Mouse Button (LMB) directly on the HUD capsule and drag it to your preferred position. Moving close to screen edges or the bottom boundary of the F1 help menu triggers magnetic docking, perfectly snapping the panel in place.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3
text.text: A compact telemetry mini-badge inside the cab gives an immediate overview of your current run: harvested hectares, total tonnage, average loss percentage, and operator skill rating from [A] (expert) to [E] (heavy losses).

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_main_text
text.text: Press Right Shift + K in the combine cab to deploy the touchscreen calibration tablet. The header displays rated engine horsepower, attached cutter width, and active crop. Fine-tuning threshing and separation parameters maximizes crop throughput while maintaining near-zero grain loss.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_rotor_text
text.text: Rotor/drum RPM and concave clearance govern threshing thoroughness. Excessive RPM shatters fragile grain, while insufficient RPM leaves unthreshed grain in the straw. The cleaning fan blows chaff out of the rear: excessive airflow blows grain onto the ground, while weak airflow clogs the sieves with trash.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_presets_text
text.text: The tablet includes pre-configured factory presets for over 25 base game and modded crops. Click 'Load Preset' to apply proven baseline settings. On combines equipped with Tier 2+ electronics, you can also save and load custom field profiles directly into combine memory.

text.name: rhm_help_trip_1
text.text: Press Right Shift + J to open the full harvest accounting hub featuring 4 tabs: 'Current Field', 'Farm Fields', 'Season Analytics', and 'Combine Fleet'.

text.name: rhm_help_trip_sub2
text.text: Current Field Trip Odometer & Operator Rank

text.name: rhm_help_trip_2
text.text: The first tab functions as a digital field odometer: tracking harvested area (ha/ac), grain yield and mass (t/l), net harvest time, field crop losses, financial loss ($/€/£), root-cause loss breakdown (Speed, Moisture, Wear, Slope), and driver efficiency rank.

text.name: rhm_help_trip_3
text.text: When entering a new field or starting a test run, hold Right Shift + R for 1 second directly from the cab. The field odometer instantly resets with an on-screen toast confirmation—no need to open the menu!

text.name: rhm_help_trip_sub4
text.text: Farm Fields, Seasonal History & Fleet Telemetry

text.name: rhm_help_trip_4
text.text: Review area and crop status for all owned fields in Tab 2, multi-season yield and financial history in Tab 3, and monitor hired AI workers in Tab 4: active operator, crop, throughput (t/h), cutter width, and knife wear.

text.name: rhm_help_croploss_1
text.text: In Realistic Harvesting, crop losses are not an abstract statistic. Grain lost over the sieves or blown out the rear is physically subtracted directly from the combine grain tank in real time or deducted from straw windrow volume, directly impacting farm finances.

text.name: rhm_help_croploss_2
text.text: - Speed & Overload: Excessive throughput overwhelms sieves, carrying grain out the back. - Moisture & Dew: Damp straw clumps together, trapping kernels inside. - Knife Wear: Blunt cutterbar knives shatter standing heads onto the ground instead of cutting. - Ground Slope: Steep side-hills shift crop mats to one side of the cleaning shoe.

text.name: rhm_help_croploss_3
text.text: When engine load exceeds 105% or sieve loss exceeds 5%, the in-cab chime sounds. In Smart Mode, the terminal sounds a cluster of 3 soft alerts spaced 1.8 seconds apart, followed by an 18-second rest interval.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_1
text.text: Every harvester can be upgraded at the vehicle dealer or farm workshop with four distinct electronics packages tailored to your farm budget and operating style.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_2
text.text: - Tier 1: Factory mechanical baseline. No electronic sensors; operator gauges speed by engine sound. - Tier 2: Adds piezoelectric sieve loss sensors (loss % on HUD) and unlocks saving custom calibration profiles into combine memory.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_3
text.text: - Tier 3: Equips an optical moisture meter, field trip odometer, financial loss tracking, and fleet telemetry. - Tier 4: Unlocks the flagship Opti-Harvest AI autopilot, automatically tuning drum RPM and fan speed on the fly and eliminating hired worker tuning errors (0% deviation).

text.name: rhm_help_ai_workers_1
text.text: Giants AI helpers, Courseplay (v7+), and AutoDrive never run at artificial flat-out speeds. RHM enforces speed limits directly at the engine server level, keeping helpers safely within the optimal 85–95% load sweet spot.

text.name: rhm_help_ai_workers_sub2
text.text: Electronics Package Impact on AI Quality

text.name: rhm_help_ai_workers_2
text.text: - Tier 1 Combines: Hired workers suffer setup deviations of up to ±18%. - Tier 2 Combines: Tuning error drops to ±10%. - Tier 3 Combines: Tuning error is reduced to ±4%. - Tier 4 Combines: Opti-Harvest AI achieves 0% error, delivering flawless factory-spec harvesting.

text.name: rhm_help_ai_workers_sub3
text.text: Courseplay & AutoDrive Unloading on the Move

text.name: rhm_help_ai_workers_3
text.text: Unloading on the move is fully accounted for: the extra mechanical drag of the unloading auger is calculated dynamically so the combine never stalls when a chase tractor pulls alongside.

text.name: rhm_help_moisture_1
text.text: Crop moisture naturally peaks in early morning hours (04:00–08:00) due to heavy dew. The prime harvesting window occurs between 11:30 and 18:30 when ambient warmth and sunlight thoroughly dry grain and straw.

text.name: rhm_help_moisture_2
text.text: Damp straw increases internal rotor friction by up to +35%, substantially lowering harvesting cruise speed and increasing fuel consumption.

text.name: rhm_help_moisture_3
text.text: Harvesting in active rain causes a sharp spike in moisture, overloading cleaning sieves, inducing heavy grain loss, and risking threshing drum choking.

text.name: rhm_help_special_1
text.text: Forage harvesters utilize a specialized 3-stage mechanical model: feed intake rollers, chopping drum, and discharge accelerator blower. Grass windrow pickers dynamically assess swath density for smooth intake.

text.name: rhm_help_special_2
text.text: Root crop harvesters must overcome substantial soil lifting drag (approx. 7 HP per meter of working width), naturally constraining field speeds to a realistic 5–8 km/h.

text.name: rhm_help_special_3
text.text: Grape and olive harvesters feature customized separation curves. The 1,100 HP NEXAT modular wide-span carrier and its NEXCO combine module are fully supported with phantom load suppression.

text.name: rhm_help_difficulty_1
text.text: Choose your preferred gameplay experience in the ESC pause menu: - Realistic: Full ASABE/DLG physics, hydrostatic braking, physical tank loss deduction, knife wear, and diurnal moisture. - Arcade: 0% engine overload, unrestricted speed limits, and zero crop losses for relaxed, casual harvesting.

text.name: rhm_help_difficulty_2
text.text: Adjust the overload warning buzzer volume (0%–100%) with an instant sound test, select your buzzer trigger mode (Smart, Continuous, Disabled), and customize HUD transparency and units.

text.name: rhm_help_difficulty_3
text.text: Click 'Reset Hints' in the settings menu at any time to re-enable on-screen tutorial hints and refresh your knowledge of all mod features.

text.name: rhm_setting_ai_tuning_long

text.name: rhm_setting_enableTutorials_long
text.text: 在收割作業期間顯示互動式引導提示。

text.name: rhm_tut_welcome_msg
text.text: 歡迎使用 Realistic Harvesting！收割機速度將根據引擎負載、作物密度與割台狀態動態適應。按下（右 Shift + K）可開啟校準終端。

text.name: rhm_tut_overload_msg
text.text: 發動機處於極限負載狀態！流體靜壓傳動正自動減速以防滾筒堵塞。請略微抬升割台或減小割幅。

text.name: rhm_tut_loss_msg
text.text: 收割機尾部穀物拋灑過多！當前滾筒轉速或篩網開度與該作物不匹配。請按下（右 Shift + K）進行精細校準。

text.name: rhm_tut_moisture_msg
text.text: 穀物濕度過高或天降細雨！潮濕的稭稈造成巨大摩擦阻力，大幅增加引擎負載與損失。建議在晴朗乾燥天氣收割。

text.name: rhm_tut_headland_msg
text.text: 在地頭轉彎抬起割台時，系統會自動記住剛才的作業速度。切入新一壟時將平穩提速，毫無頓挫。

text.name: rhm_tut_upgrade_msg
text.text: 基礎款收割機需手動調節。前往車間升級電子系統可解鎖感測器套件（第 2 級）、產量監控（第 3 級）或 Opti-Harvest AI（第 4 級）。

text.name: rhm_tut_hud_drag_msg
text.text: You can reposition the HUD anywhere across your screen by holding Left Mouse Button (LMB) on the panel, or magnetically dock it cleanly beneath the F1 menu and screen edges.

text.name: rhm_tut_trip_msg
text.text: Press Shift+J to review your field yield summary, financial loss analysis, and fleet status. To quickly reset the counter for a new field, hold Shift+R for 1 second in the cab!

text.name: rhm_tut_chopper_msg
text.text: Chopping straw consumes an extra 15â€“20% of engine power compared to laying a swath. If you need more harvesting speed on dense crops, switch to laying a swath.

text.name: rhm_setting_wear_loss_long
text.text: 模擬設備磨損造成的籽粒損失。鈍化割刀會打碎穗頭（最多增加 +3% 損失及 +15% 阻力），磨損的脫粒紋桿與篩網會漏掉未脫淨穀物（最多增加 +3% 損失）。

text.text: 季度歷史 / 所有農田

text.name: rhm_cause_speed
text.text: 速度過快與脫粒筒過載

text.name: rhm_rank_desc_a
text.text: 損失率低於 1.5%。收割機設定與行駛速度完美契合。

text.name: rhm_rank_desc_b
text.text: 損失率介於 1.5% 至 3.0% 之間。建議微調速度或凹板間隙。

text.name: rhm_rank_desc_c
text.text: 損失率介於 3.0% 至 4.5% 之間。請減速或檢查割刀鋒利度。

text.name: rhm_rank_desc_d
text.text: 損失率超過 4.5%！篩網嚴重過載或設定嚴重偏差。

text.name: rhm_advice_perfect
text.text: 採收效率極佳。所有分離參數均處於最佳平衡狀態。

text.name: rhm_advice_speed
text.text: 主要損失成因為速度過快。請減速以降低篩網負擔。

text.name: rhm_advice_moisture
text.text: 高作物濕度或晨露導致損失。請等待田間乾燥或適當減速。

text.name: rhm_advice_wear
text.text: 刀片或脫粒紋桿磨損導致損失增加。請至維修站進行保養。

text.name: rhm_advice_slope
text.text: 坡地側向傾斜導致篩網負載不均。於坡地作業時請減速。

text.name: rhm_setting_ai_limiter_desc
text.text: 當損失超過閥值時，自動限制AI僱員巡航速度。

text.name: rhm_setting_ai_threshold_desc
text.text: AI僱員開始自動煞車減速之最大容許損失百分比。

text.name: rhm_setting_volunteer_desc
text.text: 在嚴重損失區域（>3%）於收割機後方生成雜草與自生幼苗。

text.name: rhm_setting_autoreset_desc
text.text: 行駛至其他農田時，自動封存當前測量並重設計數器。
